tools.name: openBlogPost
tools.description: Open a Dometrain blog article by its slug.

slug.description: Blog post slug from the URL path /blog/{slug}/.

tools.name: openCourse
tools.description: Open a Dometrain course detail page by its slug (e.g. "from-zero-to-hero-rest-apis-in-dotnet").

slug.description: Course slug from the URL path /course/{slug}/.

tools.name: searchCourses
tools.description: Search the Dometrain course catalog by free-text query. Navigates the user to the courses listing filtered by the query.

query.description: Topic, technology, or keyword (e.g. "rest apis", "ef core").
